description: Repository-owned snapshots used to generate PalCert's webhook destination classification. Four are IANA registry exports; ipv6-deprecated-extra.csv is not — it is a reviewed supplemental deny entry transcribed from RFC 4291 for the deprecated IPv4-compatible IPv6 form, which no IANA registry lists. The generator reads only these files, so regenerating the table is reproducible offline and CI needs no network. Refresh with: pnpm webhooks:refresh-iana
policy: Any address inside any entry below is refused as a webhook destination: IANA special-purpose and multicast registry entries, plus the reviewed supplemental deprecated forms. Phase 17 has zero allow exceptions.

ipv6-deprecated-extra.csv.note: Not an IANA export. RFC 4291 §2.5.5.1 deprecates the IPv4-compatible IPv6 address, and no registry lists ::/96 as special-purpose, so it is transcribed here explicitly and reviewed as part of this repository rather than presented as a registry fact.
